headline: AJE graphic of the quote draws 2K likes/1K comments of debate fire
dek: Trump told White House reporters: 'We could take all of the oil... the Hormuz Strait is totally ours, and that's the way we will keep it.' He also claims oil flow through Hormuz exceeds pre-war levels and 97% of ships pass safely under US control.
sources: Donald Trump, White House press remarks (on record); reported by Al Jazeera liveblog entry 15:08 GMT Oct 23 and Al Jazeera English Instagram post
fault_line: Whose numbers are real — Trump's 'more oil than before the war, totally ours' or the counted 4% of normal traffic and $113 Brent?
